mapper.sql: and exists (select 1 from orders where orders.id=refund_request.order_id )
mapper.select: select * from refund_request where order_id=#{orderId} for update
select * from refund_request where out_refund_no=#{number} for update

select out_refund_no from refund_request where status in ('REQUESTED','PROCESSING','VERIFYING') and next_attempt_at<=#{now} and (lease_until is null or lease_until<=#{now}) order by next_attempt_at,out_refund_no limit 20
mapper.insert: insert into refund_request(out_refund_no,order_id,out_trade_no,transaction_id,amount_fen,status,query_only,attempts,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) select #{outRefundNo},#{orderId},#{outTradeNo},#{transactionId},#{amountFen},#{status},#{queryOnly},0,#{nextAttemptAt},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt} from orders where id=#{orderId} and number=#{outTradeNo} and amount*100=#{amountFen} and (wechat_transaction_id=#{transactionId} or (wechat_transaction_id is null and #{transactionId} is null))
